title: MAREF: Multi-Agent Recursive Evolution Framework — Agent Governance Operating System
description:
MAREF is an Agent Governance Operating System implementing a six-layer recursive governance architecture (天极/人极/地极/经卦/别卦/爻变) with an Eight-Trigrams trust state machine based on Gray Code transitions. It provides G1-G5 governance auditors (MetaCognitiveAuditor, SubgoalInterceptor, SocialImpactAssessor, EconomicGovernor, CrossInstanceGovernor), MCP bridging via sidecar, TLA+ formal specifications, and an Electron+React desktop GUI.

Key capabilities:
- Multi-agent recursive evolution with self-* (observer/diagnostician/healer/architect/executor/optimizer/knowledge) modules
- Eight-Trigrams trust state machine (8 states, Gray Code hamming-distance=1 transitions)
- G1-G5 辛顿交叉验证 governance layer (meta-cognition, subgoal interception, social impact, economic governance, cross-instance consistency)
- ZeroTrust security boundary with HMAC-authenticated MCP bridge
- TLA+ formal verification of safety properties
- Desktop GUI (Tauri/Electron + React 19 + TypeScript)
